prelude:
using F = int();
template <int N> constexpr int pick() { return N; }

pairs.plain lref: constexpr operator F&() const { return pick<R>; }
pairs.plain rref: constexpr operator F&&() const { return pick<R>; }
pairs.template lref: template <class T> constexpr operator T&() const { return pick<R>; }
pairs.template rref: template <class T> constexpr operator T&&() const { return pick<R>; }
